FN-YKZON2-1 PAG
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 2
Committee: Veterans and Military Affairs Sponsor: Senator April Weaver
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 03/14/2023
Senate Bill 2 as introduced could increase the administrative obligations of the Department of
Corrections, by an undetermined amount, to comply with the provisions of this bill prohibiting
inmates from participating in any program that train dogs to recognize scents or track humans.
